8 个音的多音 FSK + LDPC 前向纠错；全网同步到 15 秒帧，收发严格: 8-tone FSK with LDPC forward error correction; stations synchronise to 15 s frames with strict transmit/receive alternation — today's most popular HF weak-signal mode.
Eb/N0 与带宽无关，是跨模式比较灵敏度的公平口径；SNR 则依赖带宽，直接比: Eb/N0 is independent of bandwidth and is the fair basis for comparing sensitivity across modes; SNR depends on bandwidth, so comparing SNR across different modes directly is misleading.
FT8 的竞赛变体：帧长减半，灵敏度比 FT8 低约 3 dB 以上，换取比赛节: The contesting variant of FT8: half-length frames, with sensitivity more than about 3 dB below FT8, traded for contest pace.
Q 为高斯尾概率函数；Eb/N0 越高，误码率越低。: Q is the Gaussian tail probability function; the higher Eb/N0, the lower the bit error rate.
WSPR 等弱信号模式的核心，擅长纠正随机错误。: The core of weak-signal modes such as WSPR; good at correcting random errors.
「波特率 ≠ 比特率」：8PSK 每符号 3 比特，同样波特率下比特率是 BPS: "Baud rate ≠ bit rate": 8PSK carries 3 bits per symbol, so at the same baud rate its bit rate is three times that of BPSK.
一次调制/传输所承载的波形，可表示 1 个或多个比特。: The waveform carried by one modulation or transmission, which can represent one or more bits.
为极弱信号与特殊传播（EME、对流层散射）设计，支持深度平均与多普勒容忍。: Designed for very weak signals and special paths (EME, troposcatter), with deep averaging and Doppler tolerance.
二相相移键控，相位 0°/180°，最抗噪，是 PSK31 的调制基础。: Binary phase-shift keying with phases 0°/180°; the most noise-resistant, and the modulation basis of PSK31.
以符号为单位的纠错码: An error-correcting code that works on symbols
低噪放大、下变频、ADC 采样，用前导/同步字完成时间与频率同步。: Low-noise amplification, down-conversion and ADC sampling, using a preamble or sync word for time and frequency synchronisation.
信息的最小单位，取值 0 或 1。: The smallest unit of information, taking the value 0 or 1.
八相移键控，效率更高但对相位噪声更敏感。: Eight-phase shift keying: higher efficiency but more sensitive to phase noise.
判决星座点 → 纠错译码 → 恢复比特 → 信源解码还原信息。: Decide the constellation points → error-correction decoding → recover bits → source decoding to restore the information.
前一符号的拖尾叠加到后一符号，由信道带宽受限或多径引起，是数字传输的主要误差来源: The tail of one symbol overlaps the next, caused by limited channel bandwidth or multipath; the main source of error in digital transmission.
加入 CRC / 纠错码 / 交织，用冗余换取抗错能力。: Adds CRC, error-correcting codes and interleaving, trading redundancy for error resilience.
单向信标协议：只发呼号 / 网格 / 功率，配合全球监听网看传播开通情况。: A one-way beacon protocol sending call, grid and power; the global listener network reveals propagation openings.
在码字中嵌入多个校验位: Embeds several parity bits in the codeword
复用 FT8 的调制与编码，帧里装自由文本消息：把「只交换网格与信噪比」的 FT: Reuses FT8's modulation and coding but carries free text: it turns the grid-and-SNR-only FT8 into a weak-signal chat mode.
奈奎斯特第一准则：符号率不超过带宽的两倍，否则符号间互相干扰。: Nyquist's first criterion: the symbol rate must not exceed twice the bandwidth, otherwise symbols interfere with one another.
对数据做多项式除法、取余作为校验: Divides the data polynomially and uses the remainder as the check
带宽 B、信噪比 S/N 下可靠传输的理论上限（bit/s）。: The theoretical upper limit of reliable transmission at bandwidth B and signal-to-noise ratio S/N (bit/s).
强检错（AX.25 用 CRC-16、FT8 用 CRC-14），用于帧校验。: Strong error detection (AX.25 uses CRC-16, FT8 uses CRC-14), used for frame checking.
性能逼近香农极限，FT8 与现代卫星广播采用。: Performance approaching the Shannon limit; adopted by FT8 and modern satellite broadcasting.
打乱码字顺序后再发送: Shuffles the order of the codewords before sending
把信噪比换算到「每比特」口径，便于跨带宽、跨模式比较。: Converts the signal-to-noise ratio to a "per bit" basis, for comparison across bandwidths and modes.
把基带信号搬移到射频载波，经天线辐射。: Shifts the baseband signal onto the RF carrier and radiates it through the antenna.
把成串突发错误摊成随机错误，与纠错码配合使用。: Spreads bursts of errors out into random errors, used together with error-correcting codes.
把每种符号映射为 I/Q 平面上的一个点；点越密每符号比特越多，但抗噪越差。: Maps each symbol to a point in the I/Q plane; the denser the points, the more bits per symbol, but the poorer the noise immunity.
把比特映射到星座点，做脉冲成形以限带并避免 ISI。: Maps bits to constellation points and applies pulse shaping to limit bandwidth and avoid ISI.
把话音/文本/图像压缩为比特流（语音压缩、文本 Varicode 等）。: Compresses voice, text or images into a bit stream (speech compression, text Varicode, etc.).
把输入编码为受约束的码流，用 Viterbi 最大似然译码: Encodes the input into a constrained code stream, decoded by Viterbi maximum-likelihood decoding
擅长纠正成串（突发）错误，用于 JT65 等。: Good at correcting bursts of errors; used in JT65 and similar.
时间同步对微弱数字模式至关重要：FT8 / WSPR 依赖精确 UTC（误差需在: Time synchronisation is crucial for weak digital modes: FT8 / WSPR depend on accurate UTC (the error must be within 1 second), otherwise they cannot decode.
最小频移键控 / 高斯滤波 FSK，恒包络、频谱紧凑，用于 APRS 9600: Minimum-shift keying / Gaussian-filtered FSK: constant envelope and compact spectrum, used for APRS 9600 and the like.
最弱，只能发现部分错误，不能纠正。: The weakest: it can only detect some errors and cannot correct any.
正交相移键控，四相位，频谱效率翻倍，常用于卫星与数据链路。: Quadrature phase-shift keying: four phases, doubling spectral efficiency; common on satellites and data links.
正交调幅，幅度与相位同时承载信息，频谱效率高但需高线性度。: Quadrature amplitude modulation: amplitude and phase both carry information; high spectral efficiency but demanding high linearity.
每比特能量与噪声功率谱密度之比，衡量数字链路质量的核心指标，与带宽无关。: The ratio of energy per bit to noise power spectral density; the key metric of a digital link's quality, independent of bandwidth.
每秒传输的比特数：Rb = Rs × log₂M（M 为星座点数）。: Bits transmitted per second: Rb = Rs × log₂M (M is the number of constellation points).
每秒传输的符号数（符号率 Rs），与调制阶数无关，不等于比特率。: The number of symbols transmitted per second (symbol rate Rs); independent of the modulation order and not equal to the bit rate.
用幅度表示比特，最简单但抗噪差，已少用。: Represents bits by amplitude: the simplest, but with poor noise immunity and now little used.
符号率 Rs 与星座点数 M 决定每秒比特数。: The symbol rate Rs and the number of constellation points M determine the bits per second.
纠错码不是万能的：冗余越多纠错越强，但有效速率越低，需与信道条件权衡。: Error-correcting codes are not a cure-all: more redundancy means stronger correction but a lower effective rate, and must be weighed against the channel conditions.
给定带宽 B 与信噪比 S/N，可靠传输的最高速率 C = B · log₂(1: Given bandwidth B and signal-to-noise ratio S/N, the highest reliable rate is C = B · log₂(1 + S/N).
能纠正 1 位错误，是最早的纠错码之一。: Can correct a 1-bit error; one of the earliest error-correcting codes.
追加冗余位使 1 的个数满足约定: Appends redundant bits so that the number of 1s meets a convention
频移键控，用两个频率表示 0/1，RTTY 用约 170 Hz 频移。: Frequency-shift keying uses two frequencies for 0 and 1; RTTY uses a shift of about 170 Hz.
香农极限说明：要传得更快，要么加带宽，要么提高信噪比——弱信号模式（FT8、WS: On the Shannon limit: to transmit faster you must either add bandwidth or raise the signal-to-noise ratio — weak-signal modes (FT8, WSPR) trade "narrow bandwidth + long integration time + error-correcting codes" for ultimate sensitivity.
